critical_code_review_comments: Learning propose response nests 'routing' under decision.refs (not top-level refs) — spec text 'refs.routing=research_loop_appended' can be read either way. Consider documenting the location explicitly or mirroring 'routing' at the top level to reduce ambiguity for future consumers.
Refresh-record chip triggers TWO console-read increments per click in the current wiring (state read + a follow-up), which is harmless but slightly overcounts session activity. Non-blocking.
